title: Choose the visual world
question: Swiss Neo-Brutalist direction for Rial Scope. Select your preferred brutalist architectural structure.

options.label: The Zurich International Grid
options.lineage: Zurich International Typographic Style fused with modern Neo-Brutalism
options.thesis: Uncompromising Swiss architectural brutalism: stark bone-white ground, massive grotesque display type, strict 3px solid black borders, hard offset drop shadows (5px 5px 0 #000), and International Klein Blue accents.
options.viewport: Massive grotesque rate callout (1 USD = 942,000 IRR) framed by thick brutalist grid rails, hard-edged calculation blocks that depress flat on click, and an unyielding monochrome tabular historical timeline.
options.risk: Requires absolute precision in typographic hierarchy and micro-spacing rhythm to maintain clarity.

raised.raise: Stark stamped validation boxes with uppercase status marks (RECORDED, FALLBACK, REAL-TIME).
Asymmetric collapsible grid cells with crisp hairline crease dividers.

options.label: The Basel Safety-Orange Monolith
options.lineage: Industrial Swiss poster typography & high-visibility brutalism
options.thesis: High-visibility industrial brutalism: raw warm-gray concrete canvas, thick 4px black borders, vibrant safety orange highlights (#ff5500), heavy bold grotesk headlines, and zero-radius button blocks with hard 6px offset shadows.
options.viewport: Heavy modular monolith with stark orange section kickers, high-contrast revaluation comparison slabs, and raw mechanical form inputs.
options.risk: Intense visual energy that commands absolute attention across every viewport.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Ledger
options.lineage: Official transit coupon books and carbon-copy ticket registers
options.thesis: Crisp ticket coupon layout with official navy/red ruling, punched-ticket tabs, red VOID/VALID stamps, and high-density tabular receipt cards.
options.viewport: Tabbed calculation coupons with perforated tear-lines and official currency validation stamps.
options.case: Fuses brilliantly with currency revaluation and historical date tracking; adds tactile bureaucratic authenticity to the brutalist structure.
options.risk: Must maintain sharp financial instrument focus rather than looking like transit ephemera.

options.label: Pixorama Metropolis
options.case: Fuses poorly with serious financial purchasing power and 75-year historical currency analysis.
options.kept: Strict adherence to hard integer grid coordinates without blur or softening.

canonCard.label: Flat Clean Fintech SaaS
canonCard.thesis: Soft, rounded, standard flat SaaS interface with pastel gradients, light gray borders, and zero structural edge.
canonCard.viewport: Typical modern SaaS layout with standard rounded form inputs and blue primary buttons.
canonCard.risk: Bland, generic, and completely devoid of memorable visual conviction.
